topics.title: CD137/FAP (BI 765179) – 1L HNSCC/NSCLC Phase 1b (1463-0001) China Enrollment Status

background.text: China reached planned enrollment target of 6 subjects by 4 Nov 2025; 7 enrolled total as of cut-off date 2 Dec 2025 (11 screened, 4 screen failed, screen failure rate 36.4%).
background.quote: we have successfully reached the planned recruitment target allocation for the 1463-0001 trial in China (Total planned enrollment: 6 subjects) by 4Nov 2025. And we strive to enroll more patients in China.

corrected.detail: Background expanded to include cut-off date (2 Dec 2025), total screened (11), screen failed (4), and screen failure rate (36.4%) from the same evidence chunk, which were present in the source but omitted in the draft.

Topic is enrollment progress only with no risk, request, decision, or action recorded. However, the announcement of reaching target plus the note 'strive to enroll more' constitutes a reportable status update at PEC level; retained as borderline rather than filtered, but flagged as progress-only with no further substantive content.
